notes.title: MXGP3: Linux and MacOS now available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049808/9f2a9388bbde81fcb271430a79df9fe691f9be7a.png[/img]

Finally, even those using Linux and MacOS operating systems will be able to become part of the MXGP world.

The 3rd chapter of the MX series is now truly open to everyone. Have fun riding on tracks with the official MXGP and MX2 championship rosters. Start your career and become the legends of MX, or train yourself with the other challenges available, to become real champions and to improve your skills.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049808/b269e5a67cb209995573a579a7273ebae7ee222c.png[/img]

Thanks to the introduction of the Unreal® Engine 4 graphics engine, the gaming experience will be much more engaging and realistic.
Have fun customizing your rider and your bike with more than 300 modifiable elements. Make your driver unique by collecting the credits needed to make any changes you want.

MXGP3 is waiting for you. Are you ready to get on the power?

notes.title: New patch available now
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049808/ebbe662408985034b530e7275814d70c75ace908.png[/img]Hello, and first of all thanks for reporting and taking part in these first MXGP3 days.
A patch based on internal checking and community feedback has just gone live and here's the fixlist.

- Customization: custom names and numbers now visible even with Low and Medium graphics settings
- Video Options: monitor specific resolutions detection
- Video Options: added Supersampling option for high-end PC
- Race Sessions: fixed skip session causing all sessions following the one skipped to being simulated
- End Race: fixed getting stuck when all skills are at max value
- Race rewind: fixed rewind behaviours when used just before finish line and when cancelled
- Stability: fixed crashes on application quit
- Stability: fixed crashes on specific resolutions and quality levels
- Time Trial: fixed lap count not working correctly if returning to pit and back to race
- Time Trial: fixed race page to show correct weather
- Online: Added all players results menu in online qualifying
- Online: fixed not working confirm button in race rewards page
- Online: voted weather to be applied on every weekend session.
- Qualifying: consider as a valid lap the one finished after the session timer elapsed
- Audio: 2 strokes audio improved
- AI: speed and ideal times improvements
- Track Kegums: MXGP category's lap time fix; improved AI trajectories
- Track Pietramurata - Respawn splines fix
- Track Mantova: fixed width of some hoops to prevent players from skipping them; improved AI trajectories
- Localizations: fixed all spanish locale languages

Please remember to report eventual further issues through our official Customer Support at this link: http://milestone.it/supporto/?lang=en
We will keep working on game optimization and known bug fixing. Have fun!

notes.title: New resolution options and race-skipping workaround
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049808/06d20ceb7ab97e880327144396b224ef2f441d5d.jpg[/img]Thank you everyone for partecipating in these first hours after the launch of MXGP3!
Following community feedback, we have updated the resolution menu with these new options:
1920x1200
2048x1536
2560x1440
2560x1600
3840x2160

For those who are experiencing a "race skipping" issue, where they cannot run the 2nd race in a full weekend and get directly to the next GP, here is a workaround while we work on a definitive fix.
During practice and qualification, please DO NOT skip the sessions. Instead, use the fast forward time option that you can find here, and get to the end. [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28049808/dbc9e07f06b7a99cfce542fe0f258a2978091591.jpg[/img]

Thank you everyone for reporting, while we keep working on our side!

notes.title: 2 STROKE BIKES
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-mxp1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t31.0-8/17016923_802917763196119_1078720350650106740_o.jpg?oh=e816b3a220852dfe8441cc2462f91d52&oe=595A18CB[/img]

You’ve asked so many times… Now you got it!
2-Stroke Bikes: one of the most beloved and requested features. The custom rider will have 10 different 2-stroke bike models available for all the MXGP3 game modes. These kinds of bikes have been designed with a devoted physics and audio. The aim? Loyalty to pure simulation and realism.

Find the full list below:
– KTM 250 SX
– KTM 125 SX
– Husqvarna TC 250
– Husqvarna TC 125
– Honda CR250R
– TM MX 250
– TM MX 125
– Yamaha YZ250
– Yamaha YZ125
– Kawasaki KX 125

Ready to #Braaaaaaap?

notes.title: More Than Real
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-mxp1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/16298859_776739715813924_1320841015329028004_n.jpg?oh=8253864d20f06f49a20a994eb209acee&oe=59679A00[/img]

MXGP is back! The third chapter is being rebuild from the ground up to bring the gaming experience to a new level!

The new MXGP edition, based on the 2016 season, offers the player a dynamic, ever-more enjoyable gaming experience thanks to a series of innovative graphics and techniques introduced by the new Unreal®Engine 4 graphics engine which will take the game experience to a surprising new level.

Hit the gas and get ready to tackle unpredictable, dynamic weather conditions in a competition which is unique in its genre. From sun to heavy rain, every change will decisively influence the rider’s visibility and the highly-deformable ground, putting even the most expert player to the test. And it is the ground which provides the greatest challenge: mud, dust and dynamic deformations will be the master of all, while the sounds of engines running at full throttle, souped up with a brand new engine, merge with the ambient noise of chainsaws.

And if this incisive generational breakthrough, with the use of the new graphics engine, is not enough to satisfy the most discerning palates, players will also find themselves with a career mode and enhanced customization, along with all official MXGP and MX2 2016 riders, the official tracks, including the MXoN, both in offline and online modes.

Here are some useful links for you:

-Official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/MXGPVideogame/?fref=ts
-Official Instagram profile: https://www.instagram.com/mxgp_the_official_videogame/
-Official website: http://mxgpvideogame.com/

Please do join us, follow updates and provide feedback. It's goin to be loads of fun!
